import React,{useState}from'react';import{useParams,useNavigate,Navigate}from'react-router-dom';import{cars,money}from'../data/cars';import{useAuth}from'../auth/AuthContext'; export default function Booking(){const{id}=useParams(),c=cars.find(x=>x.id===id),{user}=useAuth(),nav=useNavigate();const[a,A]=useState(''),[b,B]=useState('');if(!c)return ;if(!user)return ;const days=a&&b?Math.max(0,Math.round((new Date(b)-new Date(a))/86400000)+1):0;return
{e.preventDefault();const all=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('carrent_bookings')||'[]');all.push({id:Date.now(),user:user.email,car:c.brand+' '+c.model,start:a,end:b,days,total:days*c.price,status:'รอดำเนินการ'});localStorage.setItem('carrent_bookings',JSON.stringify(all));nav('/member')}}>
